title: 고용노동부 소관 비상대비에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.text_en: Ministry of Employment and Labor ( Emergency Safety Officer ), 044-202-7077

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「비상대비에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항 중 고용노동부장관의 소관 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2022. 12. 16.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Emergency Preparedness and its Enforcement Decree, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof that fall under the jurisdiction of the Minister of Employment and Labor. <Amended Dec. 16, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(자원조사) 「비상대비에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제10조제1항 및 같은 법 시행령(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제9조제1항에 따른 자원의 조사는 이 규칙 제3조에 따른 중점관리대상업체에 대하여 매년 12월 31일을 기준으로 연 1회 실시한다. <개정 2022. 12. 16.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Resource Survey) A resource survey pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act on Emergency Preparedness (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) and Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree” ) shall be conducted once a year, based on December 31 of each year, for priority management target enterprises under Article 3 of these Rules. <Amended Dec. 16, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(중점관리대상업체의 범위) 법 제11조 및 영 제10조에 따른 중점관리대상업체는 다음 각 호의 업체 중에서 고용노동부장관이 지정하는 업체로 한다. <개정 2022. 12. 16.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Scope of Priority Management Companies) Priority management companies pursuant to Article 11 of the Act and Article 10 of the Enforcement Decree shall be those companies designated by the Minister of Employment and Labor from among the companies listed in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Dec. 16, 2022>
1. Korea Workers' Welfare Service pursuant to Article 10 of the Industrial Accident Compensation Insurance Act
2. Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency pursuant to the Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency Act
3. The Korea Human Resources Development Service pursuant to the Korea Human Resources Development Service Act
4. Technical colleges established by the Korea Human Resources Development Service pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 1 of the Korea Human Resources Development Service Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 고용노동부 소관 비상대비업무의 효율적인 수행을 위하여 고용노동부장관이 필요하다고 인정하여 지정하는 기관 또는 단체
rows.text_en: 5. Other institutions or organizations designated by the Minister of Employment and Labor as deemed necessary for the efficient performance of emergency preparedness duties under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Employment and Labor

rows.source_ko: 제4조(중점관리대상업체 지정 및 임무고지서의 발급 등) ① 고용노동부장관은 법 제11조 및 영 제10조에 따라 중점관리대상업체를 지정하였을 때에는 지체 없이 별지 제1호서식의 중점관리대상업체 지정 및 임무고지서를 중점관리대상업체의 장에게 발급하고, 별지 제2호서식의 중점관리대상업체 지정 및 임무고지서 발급대장(이하 “발급대장”이라 한다)에 그 사실을 기록하고 이를 관리하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Designation of Priority Management Target Enterprise and Issuance of Duty Notice, etc.) ① When the Minister of Employment and Laborhas designated a priority management target enterprise pursuant to Article 11 of the Act and Article 10 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall issue the Designation of Priority Management Target Enterprise and Duty Notice in Form No. 1 of the Attached Form to the head of the priority management target enterprise without delay, and record the fact in the Register of Designation of Priority Management Target Enterprise and Duty Notice Issuance in Form No. 2 of the Attached Form (hereinafter referred to as the “Issuance Register”) and manage it.

rows.source_ko: ② 고용노동부장관은 중점관리대상업체의 지정을 변경한 경우에는 그 사실을 중점관리대상업체에 통지하고, 발급대장에 그 사실을 기록하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If the Minister of Employment and Labor changes the designation of a priority management target company, he/she shall notify the priority management target company of such fact and record such fact in the issuance register.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Employment and Labor Decree No. 188, June 26, 2017>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
